A better beginning

Explore parrots for UK homes and prepare a considered enquiry. Individual birds, prices and availability are confirmed directly.

Looking for parrots for sale in the UK?

Begin by comparing species and practical needs. Crownwing’s collection covers African parrots, macaws, cockatoos, Amazons, conures, caiques, Eclectus and parakeets. Our commercial pages explain what to ask about each group before deciding on a particular bird.

Use the enquiry pages to request individual photographs, prices and proposed arrangements.

What a useful buying enquiry includes

Tell us which species interests you, your bird-keeping experience, the accommodation you can provide and your typical routine. Include questions about the individual’s age, diet, background, behaviour and records. Explain whether other birds or animals share your home.

Review the buying checklist and ownership costs before committing. Our approach puts practical suitability at the centre of the conversation.

Confirm availability, price and arrangements

Request current details of the individual bird. Confirm the price and what is included, relevant terms, any viewing opportunity and handover arrangements. Collection or delivery should only be assumed once agreed.

Prepare and download an enquiry with the species and questions you would like to discuss.
